evals.prompt: Wire pose switching into apps/mobile/src/render/ so the avatar can flip between the 4 P04 pose clips when the user taps a pose thumbnail in apps/mobile/src/features/avatar.
evals.expected_output: The agent implements the pose-switch driver inside apps/mobile/src/render/ (the only place Filament types may be imported outside the designated avatar screen), keeps the thumbnail-tap handler in the avatar feature screen, avoids per-frame allocations in the hot path, and states clearly that this is Android-verified with numbers or explicitly not yet measured.
assertions: New Filament-touching code lives under apps/mobile/src/render/ or apps/mobile/src/features/avatar/, nowhere else
The agent names the four pose clips against the doc 07 / P04-T03 convention rather than inventing new pose names
The agent either reports a real frame-time/memory measurement from a physical device or explicitly states it was not run, never a claimed number
No per-frame allocation is introduced in the pose-switch hot path per the agent's own description of the change

evals.prompt: The garment attachment code got renamed from 'leftSleeve' to 'sleeve_L' in the skeleton — now every existing avatar config renders the sleeve in the wrong place.
evals.expected_output: The agent treats a skeleton/morph rename as an asset-version bump with a migration note per doc 07, not a silent rename — it proposes or writes the version bump and migration path rather than just patching the render code to paper over the mismatch.
assertions: The agent identifies this as a registry rename requiring a version bump, citing planning/07-3d-avatar-and-garment-pipeline.md
The agent does not simply hardcode a name-mapping shim in the renderer as the permanent fix
The agent's report states the migration plan for existing avatar configs before or instead of writing code

evals.prompt: assets-validate is failing on the new anny-adult-v1 glTF export — KTX2 textures are missing and the manifest doesn't list a provenance field.
evals.expected_output: The agent fixes the asset pipeline output (adds the KTX2 textures, adds provenance to the manifest) and reruns `just assets-validate`, pasting the real pass/fail output; it does not disable or skip the validation check to get green, and it flags if any part of assets-validate is a known stub pending P04-T01.
assertions: The agent adds a provenance field to the manifest entry, citing the honesty invariant (no ungenerated/generated ambiguity)
The agent reruns `just assets-validate` and pastes real output rather than assuming green
The agent never comments out or weakens an assets-validate check to reach a passing result
If part of the budget/KTX2 check is a known stub, the agent says so explicitly rather than claiming full coverage
